UnitStatement: ChatMessage type has fields: id, role ('operator'|'assistant'), text, and optional attachments (UiAttachment[]).
ActiveSession type carries sessionId, projectRoot, persona, and mode.
PERSONA_ALIASES maps shorthand persona labels (HELP, ORCHESTRATE, AGGREGATE, RECONCILING, AGENTS) to canonical persona names (HELP_HUMAN, ORCHESTRATOR, AGGREGATION, RECONCILIATION, HELPS_HUMANS).
resolvePersona returns 'WORKING_ITEMS' unless pathname starts with '/workbench', where it normalizes the agent query param to uppercase and applies PERSONA_ALIASES.
resolveMode maps pathname prefixes to modes: '/workbench'→WORKBENCH, '/pipeline'→PIPELINE, otherwise PORTAL.
mergeAttachments deduplicates attachments by their path, with incoming items overriding existing ones.
ChatPanel is the exported React component driving harness chat: it manages draft, attachments, active session, running state, runtime status/error, and the message transcript.
ChatPanel seeds the transcript with an assistant message prompting the operator to select a Working Root and send a prompt.
The chat draft storage key is derived from projectRoot, active persona, and active mode via buildChatDraftStorageKey; it is null when no projectRoot is set.
ChatPanel resets the active session whenever projectRoot, persona, or mode no longer matches the existing session.
On draft-storage-key change, ChatPanel rehydrates draft and attachments from localStorage and records writability/warning state.
ChatPanel persists the chat draft snapshot to localStorage on changes, disabling further writes and surfacing a warning when storage is not writable.
ensureSessionBooted throws if no Working Root is selected; reuses an existing matching session, otherwise creates and boots a new harness session (optionally with opts) and stores it.
interruptTurn issues an interrupt request for the active session only when a turn is running, surfacing errors via the runtime error state.
submitDraft prevents default form submission and aborts early when both trimmed draft text and attachments are empty.
submitDraft assigns operator and assistant message ids derived from Date.now() and appends both messages optimistically before streaming.
submitDraft streams a harness turn via streamHarnessTurn, passing sessionId, message, attachment paths, and optional opts.
On a 'chat:delta' stream event, submitDraft appends the chunk text to the running assistant message.
On a 'chat:complete' stream event, submitDraft replaces the assistant message text with the completed text.
On a fatal 'turn:error' event, submitDraft constructs a HarnessApiClientError using payload errorType (default SDK_FAILURE), status (default 500), and message.
On a 'process:exit' event, submitDraft handles interrupted turns (showing 'Turn interrupted by operator.') and non-zero exit codes by building an error to throw.
If no assistant text was returned after streaming, submitDraft shows 'No assistant text was returned for this turn.'
On error, submitDraft restores the preserved draft and attachments, sets the runtime error, and removes the optimistic operator and assistant messages.
submitDraft always clears the running state in its finally block.
The chat input and submit button are disabled when no projectRoot is set or a turn is running; submit also requires non-empty draft or attachments.
The Interrupt button is enabled only while a turn is running and an active session exists.
TreeNode type (file-picker) has name, path, kind ('directory'|'file'), and optional children.
FilePickerProps requires open, projectRoot, existingPaths, onClose, and onAddAttachments callbacks.
pathParent returns the parent directory of a path, returning '/' for root or shallow paths.
pathWithinRoot returns true when a candidate path equals projectRoot or is prefixed by projectRoot plus a trailing slash.
FilePicker is the exported modal component for selecting file attachments within a project root; it returns null when not open.
On open, FilePicker resets currentDirectory to projectRoot, clears selected paths, and clears errors.
FilePicker fetches directory entries from '/api/working-root/tree?projectRoot=...&depth=1', guarding against stale results via a cancelled flag.
FilePicker registers an Escape keydown listener while open that invokes onClose.
FilePicker shows only files passing isSupportedAttachmentPath and reports the count of unsupported files hidden by the extension filter.
toggleSelection adds or removes a file path from the selected set.
addSelected builds UiAttachments from selected paths via buildUiAttachment, calls onAddAttachments, clears selection, and closes the picker.
The Up navigation guards against leaving the project root using pathWithinRoot before changing the current directory.
The picker displays allowed extensions from SUPPORTED_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS.
FileTreePanel uses a fixed tree fetch depth of TREE_DEPTH = 3.
TreeNode (file-tree) supports kinds 'directory'|'file'|'symlink' plus optional children and a truncated flag.
TreeNodeView recursively renders a tree node with directory/symlink/file icons (DIR/LNK/FILE), expand-collapse toggles, and a truncation notice.
TreeNodeView treats a directory with children as expandable; non-directories and childless nodes render as always-expanded leaves.
FileTreePanel is the exported component that loads and polls the working-root filesystem tree.
On projectRoot change, FileTreePanel resets expanded state, tree, error, and loading state.
FileTreePanel loads the tree from '/api/working-root/tree?projectRoot=...&depth=3', using a monotonic requestId to discard stale responses and only showing the loading spinner on the initial load.
FileTreePanel polls for refresh on an interval of FILE_TREE_POLL_INTERVAL_MS, skipping polls when the document is hidden per shouldPollWhenHidden.
FileTreePanel schedules refreshes on visibilitychange (per shouldRefreshForVisibilityState) and window focus via a createRefreshScheduler, restarting polling after each refresh.
toggleExpanded flips a node's expanded state keyed by node path, defaulting to expanded.
OperatorToolkitPanel is the exported panel exposing local, non-authoritative harness opts and presets via the useToolkit context.
The payload preview renders pretty-printed JSON of { opts } or a fallback message stating runtime fallback chains apply when no opts are set.
submitPreset saves a preset by name, surfacing 'Preset name is required.' when savePreset returns false, and resets the name and error on success.
The Apply/Delete preset actions are enabled only when the selected preset id exists among the available presets.
The toolkit panel edits opts fields: opts.model, opts.tools (comma/newline separated), and opts.maxTokens via opts.maxTurns input.
Notes: Field labeled opts.maxTurns; statement records the rendered control.

UnitStatement: Enabling opts.subagentGovernance reveals contextSealed, pipelineRunApproved, and approvalRef controls.
DeliverableListItem type has id, name, pkg, status, path, and a derived composite key.
KnowledgeTypeListItem type has id, label, and matchingDeliverableKeys array.
DeliverablesScan type aggregates projectRoot, scannedAt, truncated, deliverables, knowledgeDecomposition (enabled + markerFile), and knowledgeTypes.
normalizeResponse derives each deliverable's composite key via buildDeliverableCompositeKey(pkg, id) and defaults missing truncated/knowledgeDecomposition/knowledgeTypes fields.
DeliverablesProvider fetches '/api/project/deliverables?projectRoot=...' and requires deliverables, projectRoot, and scannedAt in the response or throws.
DeliverablesProvider exposes a refresh function that increments a refresh token to retrigger the scan.
useDeliverables throws 'useDeliverables must be used inside DeliverablesProvider' when used outside the provider.

ToolkitContextValue exposes hydrated, isToolkitVisible/setToolkitVisible, storageWarning/dismissStorageWarning, values/updateValues/resetValues, optsPayload, presets, selectedPresetId, and preset operations (select/apply/save/delete).
Toolkit storage warnings: STORAGE_WARNING_UNAVAILABLE when localStorage is unusable, STORAGE_WARNING_CORRUPT when stored data is invalid and reset.
ToolkitProvider hydrates state from localStorage key TOOLKIT_STORAGE_KEY, falling back to defaults and warning on corrupt JSON (removing the key) or unavailable storage.
ToolkitProvider persists state to localStorage after hydration when storage is writable, disabling writes and warning on failure.
optsPayload is derived from toolkit values via buildHarnessOptsFromToolkit, memoized on state.values.
ToolkitProvider logs opts changes via console.info once hydrated.
savePreset trims the name, returns false when empty, otherwise creates a preset via createToolkitPreset, upserts it, and selects it.
applySelectedPreset copies the selected preset's values into state, clearing the selection if the preset id no longer resolves.
deleteSelectedPreset removes the selected preset and clears the selection.
useToolkit throws 'useToolkit must be used inside ToolkitProvider' when used outside the provider.
The project root is persisted in localStorage under key 'chirality.projectRoot'.
WorkspaceContextValue exposes projectRoot, hasElectronDirectoryPicker, errorMessage/clearError, applyProjectRoot, chooseProjectRoot, and clearProjectRoot.
validateProjectRoot POSTs to '/api/working-root/validate' with the projectRoot and returns the normalized projectRoot or throws on failure.
hasElectronDirectoryPicker is true when window.chirality.selectDirectory is a function (Electron native picker available).
WorkspaceProvider restores the stored project root from localStorage on mount.
storeProjectRoot updates state and writes the project root to localStorage, removing the key when cleared.
applyProjectRoot validates a candidate root, stores the normalized value on success, and records an error message on failure.
chooseProjectRoot uses the Electron window.chirality.selectDirectory picker, handling cancellation, picker errors, and missing paths, then applies the chosen path.
useWorkspace throws 'useWorkspace must be used inside WorkspaceProvider' when used outside the provider.
isRowEmpty returns true when every value in a row trims to an empty string.
parseCsv parses CSV content into rows of string fields, handling quoted fields, escaped double-quotes (""), commas, and CRLF/LF line endings, skipping fully empty rows.
escapeCsvCell wraps a value in double quotes and doubles internal quotes only when it contains a quote, comma, or newline.
serializeCsv joins headers and per-row cells (looked up by header, defaulting to empty) into a newline-terminated CSV string.
DependencyRegisterReadResult contains headers, normalized rows (DependencyRegisterRow[]), and warnings.
normalizeRow (reader) uppercase-normalizes enum-like fields, applies normalizeDirection and normalizeDependencyType, preserves unknown extra columns, and records normalization warnings per row.
The reader emits a per-row SCHEMA_VERSION_INFERRED warning when the source CSV lacked a RegisterSchemaVersion column.
readDependencyRegister parses CSV content and returns empty headers (DEPENDENCY_CORE_COLUMNS) with no rows when the input is empty.
readDependencyRegister prepends a RegisterSchemaVersion column (and a MISSING_SCHEMA_VERSION_COLUMN warning) when the header row lacks it.
DependencyRegisterWriteOptions supports optional hostDeliverableId and previousRows (for transition validation).
requireNonEmpty throws a DependencyContractError with the given code when a required field is blank.
normalizeRow (writer) fills missing core columns, normalizes schema version and all enums, applies direction/dependency-type normalization with warnings, and trims identity/provenance fields.
validateRow requires RegisterSchemaVersion to equal 'v3.1', throwing INVALID_SCHEMA otherwise.

validateRow requires DependencyID, FromPackageID, FromDeliverableID, FromDeliverableName, DependencyClass, AnchorType, Direction, DependencyType, TargetType, Origin, FirstSeen, LastSeen, and Status to be non-empty.
DependencyID must match DEP-{PKG}-{DEL}-{SEQ} and FromDeliverableID must match DEL-XX-YY, else INVALID_IDENTITY is thrown.
When hostDeliverableId is provided, each row's FromDeliverableID must equal it or INVALID_IDENTITY is thrown.
FirstSeen and LastSeen must be ISO YYYY-MM-DD dates or INVALID_DATE is thrown.
validateRow rejects unknown enum values for DependencyClass, AnchorType, Direction, DependencyType, TargetType, Explicitness, SatisfactionStatus, Confidence, Origin, and Status with INVALID_ENUM.
ANCHOR rows must use a non-NOT_APPLICABLE AnchorType and DependencyType=OTHER, else INVALID_CLASSIFICATION is thrown.
EXECUTION rows must set AnchorType=NOT_APPLICABLE, else INVALID_CLASSIFICATION is thrown.
DELIVERABLE targets require TargetDeliverableID; non-deliverable targets must leave TargetDeliverableID empty, else INVALID_TARGET is thrown.
ACTIVE rows require both EvidenceFile and SourceRef, else INVALID_PROVENANCE is thrown.
An EvidenceQuote exceeding 30 words emits an EVIDENCE_QUOTE_OVER_30_WORDS warning.
validateSatisfactionTransitions checks each row's SatisfactionStatus change against previousRows via isValidSatisfactionTransition, throwing INVALID_SATISFACTION_TRANSITION on illegal moves.
collectHeaders emits core columns, then any non-empty extension columns, then sorted unknown extra columns.
serializeDependencyRegister normalizes rows, rejects duplicate DependencyIDs (DUPLICATE_DEPENDENCY_ID), validates each row, and validates satisfaction transitions before serializing.
serializeDependencyRegister warns ANCHOR_IMPLEMENTS_NODE_COUNT_NOT_ONE when exactly one ANCHOR row with AnchorType=IMPLEMENTS_NODE is not present among non-empty rows.
DEPENDENCY_CORE_COLUMNS defines the canonical dependency-register column order beginning with RegisterSchemaVersion and ending with Notes.
DEPENDENCY_EXTENSION_COLUMNS are EstimateImpactClass and ConsumerHint.
DEPENDENCY_CLASS_VALUES = ANCHOR, EXECUTION.
ANCHOR_TYPE_VALUES = IMPLEMENTS_NODE, TRACES_TO_REQUIREMENT, NOT_APPLICABLE.
DIRECTION_VALUES = UPSTREAM, DOWNSTREAM; legacy values INBOUND/OUTBOUND are normalized to these.
DEPENDENCY_TYPE_VALUES = PREREQUISITE, INTERFACE, HANDOVER, CONSTRAINT, ENABLES, OTHER; legacy COORDINATION/INFORMATION normalize to OTHER.
TARGET_TYPE_VALUES = DELIVERABLE, PACKAGE, WBS_NODE, REQUIREMENT, DOCUMENT, EQUIPMENT, EXTERNAL, UNKNOWN.
EXPLICITNESS_VALUES = EXPLICIT, IMPLICIT.
SATISFACTION_STATUS_VALUES = TBD, PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, SATISFIED, WAIVED, NOT_APPLICABLE.
CONFIDENCE_VALUES = HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW; ORIGIN_VALUES = DECLARED, EXTRACTED; ROW_STATUS_VALUES = ACTIVE, RETIRED.
DependencyContractError carries a code (DependencyContractErrorCode) and optional details, with name 'DependencyContractError'.
Identity patterns: DEPENDENCY_ID_PATTERN = /^DEP-\d{2,3}-\d{2}-\d{3}$/, DELIVERABLE_ID_PATTERN = /^DEL-\d{2,3}-\d{2}$/, ISO_DATE_PATTERN = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.
SATISFACTION_TRANSITION_MAP allows: TBD→{PENDING,NOT_APPLICABLE,WAIVED}; PENDING→{IN_PROGRESS,NOT_APPLICABLE,WAIVED}; IN_PROGRESS→{SATISFIED,WAIVED}; SATISFIED/WAIVED/NOT_APPLICABLE are terminal.
normalizeSchemaVersion returns the trimmed value or defaults to 'v3.1'.
normalizeDirection maps INBOUND→UPSTREAM and OUTBOUND→DOWNSTREAM, otherwise returns the uppercased value.
normalizeDependencyType maps COORDINATION/INFORMATION→OTHER, otherwise returns the uppercased value.
isValidSatisfactionTransition treats empty or identical from/to as valid and otherwise checks SATISFACTION_TRANSITION_MAP.
quoteWordCount counts whitespace-delimited non-empty tokens in a string.
EngineAdapterSubject identifies the engine adapter: 'stub' | 'anthropic-direct' | 'claude-agent-sdk'.
AgentEngineRunInput carries session, message, opts (ResolvedOpts), and optional contentBlocks.
AgentEnginePort interface exposes a readonly subject, startTurn returning AsyncIterable<UIEvent>, and interrupt(sessionId).
RuntimeEngineContract bundles a port, the public UI event allowlist, and providerMetadataAllowed:true.
PUBLIC_UI_EVENT_NAMES allowlists the public UI events: session:init, chat:delta, chat:complete, tool:result, session:complete, turn:error, process:exit.
AgentClass is 'PERSONA' | 'TASK'.
AgentInstruction carries instructionRoot, path, and content.
normalizeAgentName trims the name and replaces hyphens with underscores.
parseYamlScalar handles quoted strings, booleans (true/false), and safe integers, otherwise returning the raw string.
parseYamlInlineList parses a bracketed inline YAML list into trimmed non-empty string items.
parseFrontmatter parses leading '---' YAML frontmatter into key/values supporting scalars, inline lists, and block lists, warning on a missing closing delimiter.
asNonEmptyString returns a trimmed non-empty string or undefined.
asStringArray returns a normalized string array or undefined if the input is not an array of strings.
parseCommaSeparatedList accepts an array or comma-separated string and returns trimmed non-empty items.
extractAgentClass maps a value beginning with 'TASK'→TASK or 'PERSONA'→PERSONA (case-insensitive), else undefined.
parseAgentType extracts an AGENT_TYPE in [0..2] from a body header or a markdown table cell.
parseAgentClass extracts AGENT_CLASS from a body header or markdown table cell via extractAgentClass.
getAgentInstructionPath builds <instructionRoot>/agents/AGENT_<normalizedName>.md.
readAgentInstruction resolves the instruction root, verifies read access, and throws HarnessError PERSONA_NOT_FOUND (404) when the agent file is missing.
tryReadAgentInstruction returns undefined on a PERSONA_NOT_FOUND HarnessError and rethrows other errors.
AGENT_SUBAGENT_CONTRACT_VERSION is 1.
CHILD_RUN_EVENT_TYPES = subagent.started, subagent.progress, subagent.completed, subagent.failed.

AGENT_SUBAGENT_PREREQUISITE_POSTURE blocks executable delegation, treats child definitions as contract-only and the pattern corpus runtime as reference-only, and blocks concrete provider routing and child capability inheritance.
ChildRunStatus = queued | denied | running | completed | failed | cancelled.
ChildRunCapability = read | write | shell | mcp | network | subagent.
ChildRunCapabilityPolicy forces inheritParentCapabilities:false and tracks requested, allowed, and denied capabilities.
sortedUnique trims, dedupes, drops empties, and sorts a string list.
createStableChildRunId derives a deterministic 'child_'+sha256(parentSessionId, parentTurnId, agentName, approvalRef).slice(0,16) id.
governanceAllowsAgent returns true only when the governance decision is allowed and lists the agent in delegatedSubagents.
createDelegationChildRunRecord builds a child run that is 'queued' when allowed or 'denied' otherwise, always denying all capabilities and never inheriting parent capabilities.
For an allowed delegation, governance gate is set to 'ALLOW' with a reason noting executable exposure remains blocked by prerequisite posture; otherwise the decision's gate and reason are carried.
createAdapterObservedChildRunRecord builds an 'adapter-observed' child run from observed adapter metadata, denying all capabilities and carrying the output artifact path.
providerNeutralChildRunRecord strips the adapter field from a child run record.
childRunRecordToEventData emits the provider-neutral record plus the adapter metadata when present.

validateChildRunRecord reports issues for missing childRunId/parentSessionId/agentName, capability inheritance not blocked, queued-without-allow, denied-without-deny, and completed-without-output-artifact.
delay returns a promise resolving after the given milliseconds via setTimeout.
chunkText splits text into fixed-size chunks (default 24), returning ['ok'] for empty input.
StubAgentSdkManager recognizes test markers: UNAPPROVED_DENY_TEST, UNAPPROVED_ALLOW_TEST, INTERRUPT_SIGINT_TEST, __BOOT_SDK_FAIL__, and TURN_SDK_FAIL_TEST.
StubAgentSdkManager implements IAgentSdkManager with a per-session active-turn map.
StubAgentSdkManager.interrupt throws SESSION_NOT_FOUND (404) when no active turn exists, otherwise marks the turn interrupted.
StubAgentSdkManager.startTurn yields a session:init event with a claudeSessionId (reused or generated) and the opts model.
Under the bootstrap message with model __BOOT_SDK_FAIL__, the stub yields process:exit exitCode 1.
A message containing TURN_SDK_FAIL_TEST throws HarnessError SDK_FAILURE (500).
In 'dontAsk' mode, UNAPPROVED_DENY_TEST yields a failed bash tool:result then a denial chat:complete; UNAPPROVED_ALLOW_TEST yields a successful bash tool:result.
With INTERRUPT_SIGINT_TEST, the stub keeps the turn open for up to ~4.5 seconds awaiting interruption.
The stub streams chunked chat:delta events with ~35ms delays, emitting process:exit exitCode 130 interrupted:true if interrupted mid-stream.
On normal completion the stub yields chat:complete, session:complete, then process:exit exitCode 0, always deleting the active turn in finally.
Anthropic SDK defaults: base URL https://api.anthropic.com, version 2023-06-01, max tokens 1024, stream timeout 90000ms, max inline image 5MB, fallback model claude-sonnet-4-20250514.
Outbound policy: only hostname api.anthropic.com over https: is allowed for the Anthropic API.
Supported inline image MIME types are image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, and image/webp.
asNonEmptyString (anthropic manager) returns a trimmed non-empty string or undefined.
escapeRegExp escapes regex metacharacters in a string.
toLowercasePercentEncoding lowercases percent-encoded escape sequences in a string.
addEncodedKeyVariantCandidates and addUrlEncodedKeyVariants generate URL-encoded (and '+'-for-space) variants of an API key for redaction matching, over up to two encoding rounds.
readConfiguredApiKeys gathers the UI key, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY plus URL-encoded variants, returned sorted longest-first.
redactConfiguredApiKeys replaces any configured API key occurrence in a message with '[REDACTED_API_KEY]'.
normalizeMimeType strips parameters and lowercases a MIME type; isValidMimeTypeToken validates type/subtype token shape; isSupportedInlineImageMimeType checks the supported image set.
normalizeAnthropicBaseUrl strips trailing slashes and a trailing '/v1/messages' suffix.

validateAnthropicBaseUrl enforces REQ-NET-001: HTTPS protocol, allowlisted hostname, no credentials, and port 443 only, throwing SDK_FAILURE NETWORK_POLICY_VIOLATION on violations, and returns the origin.
getAnthropicBaseUrl reads CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_URL (default base URL) and validates it.
readAnthropicApiKey resolves the key with precedence UI key, then ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (OI-001/SCA-003), throwing SDK_FAILURE MISSING_API_KEY (503) when none is set.
getAnthropicVersion reads CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_VERSION or defaults to 2023-06-01.
getMaxTokens reads CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS, defaulting to 1024 for missing/invalid/non-positive values.
getStreamTimeoutMs reads CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_STREAM_TIMEOUT_MS, defaulting to 90000ms for missing/invalid/non-positive values.
buildAnthropicClient constructs an Anthropic SDK client with apiKey, baseURL, and an anthropic-version default header.
detectMimeType prefers a valid supported fallback MIME type, otherwise infers image MIME from file extension (.png/.jpg/.jpeg/.gif/.webp), defaulting to application/octet-stream.
readImageAsBase64 reads a file, throwing ATTACHMENT_FAILURE (400) if unreadable or if it exceeds the 5MB inline image limit, and returns base64.
readPDFAsBase64 reads a file and returns base64, throwing ATTACHMENT_FAILURE (400) when unreadable.
readPlainTextDocument reads a UTF-8 file, throwing ATTACHMENT_FAILURE (400) when unreadable.

formatContentBlocks converts content blocks into Anthropic content: text blocks, base64 image blocks, base64 PDF document blocks, plain-text document blocks, and a textual fallback for unmapped types.
readEventType/readMessageStop/readTextDelta extract the event type, detect 'message_stop', and pull streamed text from delta.text, content_block.text, or event.text.
toAnthropicStreamEventError builds a SDK_FAILURE HarnessError (default 502) from a stream error event, redacting API keys in the message.
classifyHttpError maps 401/403→INVALID_API_KEY, 429→RATE_LIMITED, >=500→API_RESPONSE_ERROR, else generic API_RESPONSE_ERROR.
readErrorDetails extracts status (status/statusCode), upstream type, message, and name from an unknown error, including nested error fields.
toAnthropicSdkError converts an SDK error with a numeric status (via classifyHttpError) or named AuthenticationError/RateLimitError into a HarnessError, redacting keys.
isAbortError detects errors named 'AbortError'.
toNetworkError maps non-abort errors to a SDK_FAILURE NETWORK_ERROR (503) 'Unable to reach Anthropic API endpoint.', redacting the cause.
AnthropicAgentSdkManager implements IAgentSdkManager, injecting an AnthropicClientFactory (default buildAnthropicClient) and tracking per-session active turns.
AnthropicAgentSdkManager.interrupt throws SESSION_NOT_FOUND (404) when no active turn exists, else marks interrupted and aborts the AbortController.

AnthropicAgentSdkManager.startTurn yields session:init, then handles bootstrap and test markers, reads the API key, formats content, and streams a real Anthropic messages.create request with an abort signal and timeout.
The Anthropic turn installs a stream timeout (getStreamTimeoutMs) that aborts the request and later throws SDK_FAILURE REQUEST_TIMEOUT (504).
The Anthropic streaming request sends model (or fallback), stream:true, max_tokens, and a single user message of resolved content.
During streaming the manager yields chat:delta for text deltas, throws on 'error' events, and breaks on message_stop, then emits chat:complete/session:complete/process:exit 0.
On error the Anthropic turn emits process:exit 130 (interrupted) if interrupted, converts timeouts/SDK/network errors to HarnessError, and always clears the timeout and active turn in finally.
api-key-store (DEL-02-06) reads the UI-provided API key from a process-global set by the Electron main process storage adapter; key material MUST NOT be logged.
The UI API key process-global variable name is '__CHIRALITY_UI_API_KEY__'.
getUiApiKey returns the stored UI API key when it is a non-empty trimmed string, otherwise undefined.
hasUiApiKey returns true when getUiApiKey() is defined.
